name: Emma – AI Receptionist for Phone, WhatsApp & Website Chat
author: stimhaus

sections.description:
Emma is the AI receptionist for small businesses: salons, barbers, restaurants, practices, shops and more. Swiss made. She answers your customers on your website, on WhatsApp and, on the Full plan, on the phone. Day and night, in your customer’s language, with the information you give her.

Talk to Emma right now, before you install anything: open stimhaus.ai, tap Answer on the ringing phone and ask her anything. It is free, from your browser (microphone needed).

Why an AI receptionist?

  • Calls come in while you are with a customer, and nobody picks up.
  • The same questions come back all day: opening hours, prices, address, availability.
  • Your website gets visits at night and on Sundays, when nobody is there to answer.

Emma answers all of them, the way you would, and lets you know what matters.

What Emma does

  • On your website: a small chat bubble appears in the corner of every page. Visitors ask, Emma answers.
  • On WhatsApp: a visitor can start on your site and continue on WhatsApp.
  • On the phone (Full plan): Emma picks up your calls day and night, takes and manages bookings, passes messages on to you via WhatsApp, and every call is transcribed.
  • In your customer’s language: Emma answers in the language your customer writes or speaks.
  • Bookings (Pro and Full): Emma takes and manages your customers’ bookings, syncs with your calendar and sends a confirmation to the customer. On Light, Emma answers questions and tells customers how to reach you.
  • Takeaway orders (Pro and Full): Emma takes your customers’ takeaway orders.
  • Your own Emma WhatsApp number (Pro and Full).

You set her up by talking to her

Send Emma a WhatsApp message, for example “We are closed on 24 December” or “A haircut is 45 CHF”, and she uses it right away. On Pro and Full, you can also teach her your business from your dashboard, with the Configure Emma button.

You stay in control

  • Nothing goes live without your approval: Emma shows you what she will tell your customers, and you approve it.
  • Read every conversation in your Stimhaus dashboard and reply yourself when you want.
  • On Pro and Full, the day’s summary every morning by e-mail.

Who is Emma for?

  • Hair salons, barbers, beauty and spas: hours, prices, bookings, by chat and by phone.
  • Restaurants and cafés: opening hours, menu questions, bookings and takeaway orders.
  • Practices (dentists, physiotherapists, vets and more): opening hours, address, appointments.
  • Shops and WooCommerce stores: product questions, delivery, opening hours.
  • Web agencies and freelancers: add Emma to the WordPress sites you build for your clients; each business activates its own Emma.

Plans (USD)

  • Light: 90 days free, then 19 USD/month. No credit card. The Emma bubble on your website, Emma WhatsApp, answers about prices, opening hours, address and useful details, in your customer’s language, day and night, 100 customer messages per month. We let you know 30 days before the free period ends; cancel at no cost.
  • Pro: 49 USD/month. Everything in Light, plus your dedicated Emma WhatsApp number, unlimited messages, bookings taken and managed, takeaway orders, calendar sync, confirmations to the customer, marketing campaigns to your customers that you switch on, and the day’s summary every morning by e-mail.
  • Full: 99 USD/month, first month free. Everything in Pro, plus Emma on the phone, day and night: she takes and manages bookings by phone, passes messages on via WhatsApp, and every call is transcribed.

No commitment. Details: stimhaus.ai. This plugin itself is free: it adds Emma to your website once you paste your Emma code.

Swiss made

Emma is made in Switzerland by Stimhaus, a Swiss company. Your customers’ conversations are used to answer them and to show them to you, with no advertising.

External services

This plugin connects your website to Emma by Stimhaus, an AI assistant service operated by Stimhaus (Switzerland). Nothing is loaded until you paste your Emma code in the plugin settings.

  • What is loaded: once your code is saved, every public page of your site loads the Emma chat bubble script from https://stimhaus.ai/emma.js, with its fonts and images from https://stimhaus.ai.
  • When a page loads: the bubble asks the Stimhaus server (https://stimhaus.ch) for your Emma settings (your site number only) and records that it was shown on your site (your domain name only; nothing about the visitor).
  • What is sent, and when: when a visitor writes to Emma in the bubble, their message, your site number, the visitor’s language and a random conversation identifier are sent to the Stimhaus server (https://stimhaus.ch) so that Emma can answer. On a product page, the product name and its address are sent too. When a visitor taps “Continue on WhatsApp”, the bubble records one click for your site (site number only), and the conversation then continues on WhatsApp (a Meta service).
  • Terms of service: https://stimhaus.ai/en/cgv
  • Privacy policy: https://stimhaus.ai/en/confidentialite
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Get your Emma code: go to stimhaus.ai and activate Emma on WhatsApp (about 2 minutes). She asks a few short questions (business name, city, e-mail, website), shows you what she will tell your visitors, and sends you your code.
  3. In WordPress, open Settings → Emma by Stimhaus, paste the code and click Save. Emma appears on your website.

Want Pro or Full right away? You can activate them directly, without starting on Light: stimhaus.ai.
sections.faq:
What is an AI receptionist?

An assistant that answers your customers for you: questions about your hours, prices and address, bookings, messages. Emma does it on your website, on WhatsApp and, on the Full plan, on the phone.

Can I try Emma before installing?

Yes. Open stimhaus.ai, tap Answer on the ringing phone and talk to her, for free, from your browser (microphone needed).

Can Emma answer my phone?

Yes, on the Full plan (99 USD/month, first month free). Emma answers the calls to your Emma number day and night. You can forward your usual number to her: the forwarding codes are in your dashboard.

Do I need a Stimhaus account?

Yes. You activate Emma on WhatsApp from stimhaus.ai, in about 2 minutes, and she sends you the code to paste in this plugin.

How much does it cost?

Light: 90 days free, then 19 USD/month, no credit card. Pro: 49 USD/month. Full: 99 USD/month, first month free. No commitment.

Which languages does Emma speak?

Emma answers in your customer’s language: they write or speak in their language, she answers in the same one.

Can Emma take bookings?

On Pro and Full, yes: Emma takes and manages your customers’ bookings, syncs with your calendar and sends a confirmation to the customer. On Light, Emma answers questions and tells customers how to reach you.

Does Emma read my WordPress pages?

No. Emma answers with what you tell her (hours, services, prices, address and more). This keeps her answers exactly as you want them.

Where do I change what Emma says?

Send her a WhatsApp message: your hours, services and prices are updated right away. On Pro and Full, you can also use the Configure Emma button in your dashboard.

Will Emma say things I did not approve?

Nothing goes live without your approval: Emma shows you what she will tell your customers, and you approve it.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes, the bubble works on WooCommerce stores like on any WordPress site. Emma answers with what you tell her about your products, prices and delivery.

Does the plugin slow down my site?

The bubble is loaded at the end of the page (deferred), after your content.

I build websites for clients. Can I add Emma for them?

Yes. Install the plugin on each client’s site; each business activates its own Emma and pastes its own code.

Can I cancel?

Yes, at any time, at no cost. On Light, we let you know 30 days before the free period ends.

Where do I get help?

Ask your question in the support forum of this plugin, or write to admin@stimhaus.ch.

How do I remove Emma?

In Settings → Emma by Stimhaus, tick “Remove Emma from my website” and click Save, or deactivate the plugin.
